brief: A display stand with the large platform on a spike where three bases meet.

requirements.requirement: Display stand with the large platform on a spike
requirements.evidence: Mount spike spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 fitted with platform-lrg accessory (Platform, large, ~52x60mm) via setSpikeAccessory.

Three full bases piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full and piece:0,1,0;full meet at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0, where the mount spike is placed. House rules applied: capOpenFaces (12 solid caps) and lockJoints (3 joint bolts). check_build ok, meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Built a three-base triangular cluster with a mount spike at the shared junction carrying the large platform, capped open faces and locked joints; verified with check_build (meshClash clear).

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Building your display stand — a large platform on a spike where three bases meet. First I'll check the current build and where a spike can sit.

result.note: A spike stands where three bases meet at a corner: place three bases around one junction first. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

parts.name: Platform, small
parts.use: The plate a mount spike passes through and traps, so a cluster gets a flat working surface that belongs to no single cell.

parts.name: Platform, large
parts.use: The plate a mount spike passes through and traps, so a cluster gets a flat working surface that belongs to no single cell.

events.text: Only one base exists, so no three-way junction yet. I'll add two adjoining bases to form a triangular cluster.

warnings.message: 1 part(s) could slide apart (1 piece(s)); joint bolts lock them.
2 part(s) could slide apart (2 piece(s)); joint bolts lock them.

offersNear.note: Open offers at the base just added (valid until the next change): apply one by its socket, no find_sockets needed.

events.text: Mount spike is placed at the junction. Now I'll fit the large platform onto it.

result.note: ok covers rule errors only. meshClash must read "clear" for the meshes to be checked and clear.
